title: E-commerce & Retail
standingRules: Order-status questions get the tracking answer FIRST, then anything else.
Never promise stock, shipping dates or refunds in drafts — quote system data or escalate.
Peak-season volume spikes are normal; alert on pattern changes, not raw volume.
compliance: Refund and return commitments follow the published policy verbatim — no improvised exceptions in drafts.

corridorHints.review-response: Product reviews mentioning safety issues escalate immediately regardless of rating.
corridorHints.document-intake: Supplier invoices reconcile against POs and received quantities, not just totals.
corridorHints.daily-brief: Include yesterday's order count and refund count in every brief.
